title: Successor step for alternating quantifiers
statement: Let $V$ be a language of binary strings, let $m,k\in\mathbb{N}$, let $b$ be either the existential or universal quantifier, and let $w$ be a binary string. The alternating predicate at $k+1$ rounds with initial quantifier $b$ holds for $w$ exactly when the corresponding quantifier $b$ over strings $u$ of length $m$ holds for the predicate at $k$ rounds with the opposite initial quantifier, evaluated on the pair encoding of $w$ and $u$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean choice $b$ of initial quantifier
